description: A type with a single value such as `'GET'` or `42`. Unions of literals describe closed sets of options.
Inference turns literals into their base type (`string`, `number`) when the value can change: `let` variables and object properties.
Const assertion: infers the narrowest literal types and marks arrays and properties `readonly`. Type-level only.
Derives the union of element types from an array or tuple value.
